build_question_answering_pipeline: build a QuestionAnsweringPipeline instance using an adapter_id to load a HuggingFace QA model
run_question_answering: run the QuestionAnsweringPipeline with a question and context dict to extract an answer with confidence score
create_qa_pipeline_call: create a call to the pipeline passing question and context strings as input dictionary keys
review_QuestionAnsweringPipeline_class: review the QuestionAnsweringPipeline class that wraps transformers QuestionAnsweringPipeline for adapter-based inference
summarize_qa_pipeline_output: summarize the pipeline output containing answer text, start and end offsets, and a confidence score
